info.title: BigBike Backend API
info.description: REST API for BigBike — Vietnam's premium motorcycle marketplace. Rewrite of WordPress backend. All endpoints return ApiDataResponse<T> or ApiListResponse<T> envelopes.

get.description: Readable by any signed-in admin so every staff member can see why the panel refuses to save. `canToggle` reports whether THIS caller may change the state (DEVELOPER role only). `uploadCount` is the number of in-flight admin uploads. Admin-panel scope only — the storefront is never placed in maintenance and customers can always order.

put.description: Restricted to the DEVELOPER role by an exact role-name check, NOT by permission: SUPER_ADMIN's wildcard `*` satisfies every permission check, so a permission could not express this rule. SUPER_ADMIN therefore receives 403. While state=ACTIVE every other admin write returns 423 MAINTENANCE_ACTIVE (423, not 503, because nginx intercepts 503 and replaces the body).

400.description: state is not NORMAL, UPCOMING or ACTIVE

403.description: Caller is not the DEVELOPER role (includes SUPER_ADMIN)

AdminBearerAuth.description: Admin JWT access token. Obtain via POST /api/v1/auth/login. Header: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>

CustomerSession.name: bb_session
CustomerSession.description: Customer session cookie. Set automatically after POST /api/v1/customer/auth/login.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfHeader.description: CSRF token required for all cart/checkout mutations. Value must match the bb_csrf cookie set by the server.

Conflict.description: Resource conflict (e.g. duplicate email or code)

permissions.description: Must be dependency-closed. The wildcard permission cannot be granted to custom roles.
Must be dependency-closed. Missing dependencies return VALIDATION_ERROR with MISSING_PERMISSION_DEPENDENCY details.

authorEmail.description: Detail-only; omitted from admin list items.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Admin-editable profile fields only. email, firstName and lastName are read-only on this API.

displayName.description: Null or omitted leaves the stored display name unchanged.

phone.description: Null or omitted leaves the phone unchanged; blank clears it. Common separators are accepted, then the value is normalized and checked against both local 0… and legacy +84… forms before storage.

reason.description: Audit-only reason; not stored on the customer row.

avgOrderValue.description: Non-CANCELLED totalSpent divided by non-CANCELLED orderCount; zero when count is zero.

firstOrderAt.description: Full-history timestamp; cancelled orders remain included.

lastOrderAt.description: Full-history timestamp; cancelled orders remain included.

total.description: All customer rows, including synthetic guest-order rows.

vip.description: Customer rows, including synthetic rows, whose non-CANCELLED lifetime spend reaches 10,000,000 VND.

newLast30Days.description: Non-synthetic registered accounts created in the previous 30 days.

active.description: Non-synthetic registered accounts whose status is ACTIVE.

AdminAnalyticsPeriodSummary.description: Aggregate revenue metrics for the requested date range. All amounts in VND (BigDecimal serialized with scale 2).

paidRevenue.description: Recognized revenue: SUM(totalAmount) where status = COMPLETED. Response name is retained for compatibility.

avgOrderValue.description: grossOrderValue / orderCount. Zero when orderCount is 0.

date.description: ISO-8601 date YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone.

revenue.description: Daily grossOrderValue (same REVENUE_EXCLUDED set as summary).

productKey.description: COALESCE(product_pk, product_id::text). Stable identifier covering both admin-created and regular products.

productName.description: Product name snapshot from order line item.

customerKey.description: COALESCE(customer_id::text, customer_email). Stable group key preventing split rows on email change.

orderCount.description: COUNT of orders excluding RANKING_EXCLUDED order statuses.

avatarUrl.description: MinIO object URL (/media/customers/...) for the customer's own uploaded avatar; null when no avatar is set (client renders an initials badge)

paymentMethod.description: Chỉ nhận COD hoặc BANK_TRANSFER (PAY_RULE_001, owner decision 2026-07-21). Bỏ trống sẽ được normalize thành COD; mã khác, kể cả BACS legacy, bị 400.

authorAvatarUrl.description: Linked customer's current avatar URL when the review was submitted while logged in; resolved live at read time (not a snapshot). Null for guest reviews or when the customer has no avatar.

authorName.description: Required for guests. Ignored for an authenticated customer.

authorEmail.description: Optional for guests. Ignored for an authenticated customer.

photos.description: Each object must be an unclaimed upload for the same product.

website.description: Honeypot field — real clients leave this empty/omitted. Non-empty value (after trim) is silently dropped server-side: response is success-shaped 201 but no review is persisted.

cancelReason.description: Required when status is CANCELLED. Stored internally on orders.cancel_reason and not shown to customers.

externalLink.description: Historical compatibility field. It is retained in responses but is not accepted or used for new banner navigation.

link.description: Effective banner link. When available, this is the linked product detail path; historical external links are not used.

noIndex.description: Cờ 'không cho Google hiển thị' bản tiếng Việt (V222 bài viết, V371 mở rộng cho sản phẩm/danh mục/thương hiệu). null = giữ nguyên. BUSINESS_RULES SEO_RULE_001.

noIndexEn.description: Cờ 'không cho Google hiển thị' bản tiếng Anh (V371). null = giữ nguyên. Chỉ là ghi đè thủ công — ngưỡng đủ nội dung EN (SEO_RULE_002) tính động, không ghi đè được qua API.

WritableVideoProvider.description: Providers accepted on write. TikTok/Facebook may exist only in legacy read responses.

videoUrl.description: For video items: a YouTube URL or an internal Media Library video URL matching videoProvider.

url.description: YouTube URL or internal Media Library video URL matching provider.

UpsertProductRequest.description: Full product create/update payload. Create accepts DRAFT only; ordinary PATCH keeps the stored lifecycle. Publishing uses ProductPublishRequest.

categoryIds.description: Ordered category ids; the first item is the primary category. Required and non-empty on create; omitted on PATCH keeps the current links.

categoryId.description: Temporary singular alias for a one-item categoryIds array. Must not be sent together with categoryIds.

publishStatus.description: Lifecycle hint constrained by the operation: create must be DRAFT and ordinary update cannot change the stored state.

available.description: Availability toggle for products without variants.

items.description: Polymorphic bilingual DescriptionBlock. Video blocks accept provider youtube or upload on write; legacy TikTok/Facebook values are read-only compatibility.

category.description: Primary category: the first entry of categories, retained for compatibility.

categories.description: All assigned categories in stable primary-first order, without duplicates.

homepageBlock.description: Homepage placement slot. NONE = not pinned.

homepageOrder.description: Manual pin priority inside the homepageBlock. Lower = appears earlier; null = unpinned.

brandId.description: Brand slug on the import wire.

publishStatus.description: Exported for completeness and ignored on import; import always saves DRAFT.

descriptionBlocks.description: Import accepts only feature blocks with side left or right.

noIndex.description: V371 — đã resolve theo `lang` của request: lang=vi → cờ VI; lang=en → cờ EN HOẶC bản EN chưa đạt ngưỡng SEO_RULE_002.

UpsertCategoryRequest.description: Create requires canonical Vietnamese name/slug and translations.en.name. PATCH is presence-sensitive: omitted fields remain unchanged.

visible.description: Independent storefront visibility patch; false is rejected if a direct child remains visible.

showOnHomepage.description: Independent homepage placement; omitted on create while false by default.

seo.description: Omit to preserve; {} clears all stored Category SEO.

BrandTranslationContent.description: Brand name and slug are shared across VI/EN (BRAND_RULE_001/003) and are NOT part of this block. Legacy clients may still send name/slug here; the server ignores them.

UpsertBrandRequest.description: Create requires slug and name. PATCH is presence-sensitive: an omitted field stays unchanged, so clearing text requires sending an empty string (description) and clearing an image requires url: "". Neither visible nor isVisible is accepted here — Trash/restore go through the dedicated endpoints.

slug.description: Shared VI/EN URL path. Changing it auto-creates a 301 redirect from the previous /brands/{slug}.

description.description: Send "" to clear; omit to preserve.

showOnHomepage.description: Independent homepage brand-carousel placement; defaults to true on create.

logo.description: MinIO whitelist applies to a new url (MEDIA_RULE_002); alt is overwritten on every save, so always send it.

banner.description: Desktop brand hero. Same MinIO whitelist and alt-overwrite behaviour as logo.

mobileBanner.description: Stored but not currently rendered by the storefront; same MinIO whitelist as logo/banner.

seo.description: Omit to preserve; {} clears all stored Brand SEO including the share image.

affectedProductCount.description: Products whose links to the deleted category tree will be removed.

reassignedProductCount.description: Affected products with no remaining category links, which will receive uncategorized.

noIndex.description: Cờ 'không cho Google hiển thị' bản tiếng Việt (V222). null = giữ nguyên. BUSINESS_RULES SEO_RULE_001.

noIndexEn.description: Cờ 'không cho Google hiển thị' bản tiếng Anh (V371). null = giữ nguyên. Ngưỡng đủ nội dung EN (SEO_RULE_002) tính động, không ghi đè được qua API.

UpsertArticleRequest.description: Presence-flag upsert payload. BigBike Admin derives seo.canonicalUrl from the Vietnamese slug.

videoUrl.description: Writable sources are a valid YouTube URL or an internal Media Library video URL.

PatchHomeVideoRequest.description: Omitting videoUrl preserves a legacy URL while updating unrelated fields. Supplying videoUrl enforces YouTube or internal Media Library only.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope used by all error responses

staffNote.description: Message shown to staff on the maintenance overlay

expectedAt.description: Display only; never triggers a transition

canToggle.description: True only for the DEVELOPER role
